articles.title: Letter: the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program Did a Good Job This Spring
body: To the editor: Please keep the bike repair clinic in the budget. Many of us on Rowan Lane use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the January meeting.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Rowan Lane for 9 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
Nora Haddad, Foxglove Heights
